rationale.conceptual: Multi-part DFT workflow involving geometry optimization, magnetic ground state determination, electronic structure, Curie temperature estimation, and extensive mechanical testing. While the underlying method (plane-wave DFT with PBE) is established, the careful combination and extraction of multiple properties requires non-trivial implementation and understanding of materials physics.
rationale.execution: The workflow has 6 sequential stages with dependencies: building structure, relaxation, band structure, Curie calculation, tensile tests (many strain points), and final assembly. Requires setting up Quantum ESPRESSO, pseudopotential management, parsing outputs, and handling a multi-step pipeline, but not excessively long or fragile.
